chart_path.description: Path (relative to the consumer repo root) of the deployable Helm chart helm-check lints/templates and cluster-smoke installs. Required for chart consumers; irrelevant when image_only is true.

compose_file.description: Path (relative to the consumer repo root) of the canonical Compose file the gate derives build facts from (v0.6). `docker buildx bake --print` on this file is the published build plan; the plan job annotates it into the BOM and emits the build matrix from it.

image_only.description: When true, skip helm-check and cluster-smoke (and omit them from the Security Gate blocking set) — for infra/image-only repos that build and vuln-scan images without a deployable app chart. Default false keeps app callers unchanged (helm + smoke still blocking).

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace cluster-smoke creates and installs the release into.

release.description: Helm release name helm-check templates under and cluster-smoke installs as.

smoke_resources.description: CSV of gate-owned smoke catalog module ids (e.g. postgres-pgvector,gateway-crds) cluster-smoke provisions before helm install. Unknown ids are blocked by the smoke-resource-unknown lint rule. Default "" provisions none. (Wired by T-7.)

values_local.description: Path (relative to the consumer repo root) of the chart values file for local/CI installs (locally-built image tags, pullPolicy: Never). Rendered by helm-check and cluster-smoke on top of the chart's default values.
